final: WITH combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, avg_optvolrt - (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) FROM combinations) AS deviation FROM combinations), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_type_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT d.tradekind, AVG(d.avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(d.deviation - a.avg_type_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > a.avg_type_deviation GROUP BY d.tradekind
